observations.code_quote: A request that passes the quota check and results in a 304 (ETag match) is counted on the separate `local_evaluation_not_modified_requests` counter. The usage report bills these at 1 unit each, the same as a `/decide` request, instead of the 10 units a full local evaluation response costs.
